title: Service status
description: B1, status up: what a data-layer service reports to the control plane's status listener, from its own container.

generation.description: The generation the service is running.

state.description: starting: not yet serving, such as the database applying its schema, or intake waiting for the database. running: serving. failing: it cannot serve, and keeps trying; the reason says why.

reason.description: Why the service is starting or failing, in one line of printable text: vhd status shows it to the server manager.

accepted.description: Intake only: telemetry events taken into the database since it started.

dropped.description: Intake only: telemetry events dropped since it started, because they broke the events contract or the database was unavailable.
